_comment: Jornal Vascular Brasileiro (J Vasc Bras). Every rule below was read in the journal's own instructions on 2026-09-23. [A] = https://www.jvascbras.org/instructions (current, most complete); [B] = https://jvascbras.org/page/report-guidelines; [C] = SciELO instructions (older; used only where [A] is silent, marked). Re-read [A] before each submission: the page shows no last-updated date.
name: Jornal Vascular Brasileiro (J Vasc Bras)
_csl: [A] Vancouver, superscript numbers in order of first citation; more than six authors: first three + et al. Local style csl/jornal-vascular-brasileiro.csl (NLM superscript with et-al-use-first=3).

reference_docx._comment: [A] A4, double-spaced, 2.5-cm margins, Times New Roman 12, left-aligned, bold section headings, italic subheadings. Line numbers: not stated in [A]; kept on (harmless, helps reviewers). Page numbers: [C] 'Numere todas as páginas'.

title._comment: [A] short title max 50 characters with spaces, no abbreviations, in the manuscript's language. Title length not stated. Titles in Portuguese AND English.

keywords._comment: [A] keywords in Portuguese and English, compliant with DeCS; printed after each abstract (main document order: title PT, title EN, abstract PT, keywords PT, abstract EN, keywords EN). Minimum 3 only in the older [C]; [A] gives no number.

authors._comment: [A] ORCID for all authors; 8 authors, more only with a statement justifying each one.

abstract._comment: [A] primary original research: structured abstract, max 250 words, in Portuguese and English with identical content ([C]); no abbreviations in title or abstract; trial registration number and registry in the last line of the abstract.

main_text._comment: [A] 'Electronic word count should start at Introduction and end at Conclusions', excluding title page, abstracts, tables, figures and references. Sections: 'Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion, or equivalent'.

references._comment: [A] 45 for primary original research. No personal communications; avoid theses and congress abstracts; prefer the past 5 years; cite Brazilian and Latin American authors (LILACS, SciELO, J Vasc Bras).

figures._comment: [A] legends listed together at the end of the manuscript; figures as separate JPEG/GIF/TIFF files, 300 dpi minimum. No maximum stated.

tables._comment: [A] tables in the main document after the references, one per page; Word table tool, horizontal lines only. No maximum stated.

_required_declarations: [A] ethics approval number (Parecer Consubstanciado, not only the CAAE), COI, funding, data availability statement and author contributions go on the title page. AI use: declare only if used beyond language editing or translation (Methods or final note), so it is not required here but listed in human_checks.

submission._comment: [A] double-blind review; separate title page file (template linked from [A]); author and institution names removed from the main document ([C]).

revision.author: Authors
revision._comment: [A] 'Revised manuscripts should clearly indicate changes made to the text, in red font preferably' (PT: 'de preferência em vermelho'). Tracked changes are not mentioned. Deleted text struck through in red so removals are also visible; set "deleted": "omit" to drop it.

human_checks: Title includes the study design (e.g. prospective cohort, cross-sectional study) [A].
Title and abstract have no abbreviations; the short title (max 50 characters) has none either [A].
Ethics: approval number from the Consolidated Opinion (Parecer Consubstanciado), not only the CAAE, in the text and on the title page [A].
Informed consent stated in the article [A]; case reports and therapeutic challenges follow CONEP Carta Circular 166/2018 [A].
Randomized trial: registry and number (ReBEC UTN for Brazil) in the last line of the abstract and on the title page [A].
Preregistration: state in the acknowledgments whether the research was preregistered [A].
AI: declare any use beyond language editing or translation (tool, version or access date, purpose), in Methods or as a final note [A].
EQUATOR checklist uploaded with the manuscript page for each item [A][B]; Society for Vascular Surgery reporting standards if applicable [B].
ICMJE conflict-of-interest form completed by every author; Publication Agreement and Copyright License signed [A].

Author contributions use the journal's categories (Conception and design; Analysis and interpretation; Data collection; Writing the article; Critical revision; Final approval; Statistical analysis; Overall responsibility) [A, title-page template].
References: no personal communications; Brazilian and Latin American literature considered; mostly past 5 years [A].
revision_checks: Deadline: revised version within 1 month; ask jvascbras@organizasecretaria.com.br for an extension [A].
Submit as a revision of the same manuscript in ScholarOne, never as a new submission [A].
Justify every disagreement with a reviewer comment [A].

secondary._comment: [A] guidelines, consensus, systematic/integrative review, meta-analysis. Abstract 'Structured or not' in the English table ('Não estruturado' in the Portuguese table): structure kept optional here. Title must include the design (narrative review, systematic review, scoping review). Chronological literature descriptions are not accepted.

case-report._comment: [A] case report or series: unstructured abstract 150, text 1,500, 25 references; sections Introduction, Case Description, Discussion; only rare entities, pioneering or innovative treatments, or unexpected diagnostically documented results.

heading.pt: Parte II – O que foi feito

therapeutic-challenge._comment: [A] therapeutic challenge: 150 / 1,500 / 25; four parts. PT headings are this kit's translation, check the journal's template.

letter._comment: [A] letter to the editor: 350 words, references optional; must address recently published articles of the same issue.
